title: Correct current calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply Ohm's Law (I = E/R) to find the circuit current of 0.015 A.

title: Charge calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate the total charge using q = I × t, yielding 0.27 C.

title: Electron count calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the number of electrons using n = q/e, obtaining approximately 1.7 × 10¹⁸.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: All numerical answers must include correct units (A, C, and unitless count for electrons).

title: Circuit model understanding
description: Important: Solution must correctly treat the battery as ideal (ignoring internal resistance) and the resistor as the only load.

title: Scientific notation
description: Optional: Expressing the electron count in proper scientific notation (e.g., 1.7e18) demonstrates additional precision.

title: Incorrect internal resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student incorrectly incorporates internal resistance despite problem stating it is not considered.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student confuses charge flow direction or uses negative charge values without justification.
